model: Urban Commuter Cruiser 3 speed - Step Through Frame
description:
Super heavy duty, feature-filled, THREE SPEED bicycle for those needing the convenience of a step through frame.

For those seeking heavy duty bicycle, which we have configured with lots of upgrades, The Urban Commuters are ideal choices. Rated for riders up to 450 pounds, or for those who just want a solid, reliable ride, these value packed bikes are the right choice. The Urban Commuters feature the most durable wheels in our industry not found on any other bicycle brand. Exclusive Worksman Alloy Rims with 11g Stainless steel spokes are just the start. Thicker than normal 1/2x3/16" chains and 3/16" front sprocket account for a stronger drive system than conventional bikes. The Urban Commuter features a front drum brake (also a Worksman exclusive) that works well for smooth stops in wet or dry conditions and a rear 3 Speed Coaster (foot) Brake for sure stopping power. An easy to use gear shifter sits atop the upright super ergonomic handlebars with extra cushioned hand grips . The classic frames are fully lugged and hand brazed, just as they have been for 100+ years! But that is not all. These frames are made using a heavier gauge steel tubing than is used on ordinary bikes. These bikes are incredibly solid and give you the feel and confidence that one can only get when riding such a classic vehicle. To prevent flats, these durable rides include Exclusive WTC Kevlar Belted tires and Puncture resistant tubes . A precision sealed crank set for even greater durability and smoother pedaling is standard on these beauties. All new Black Polycarbonate Resin fenders & Chainguard (no rust, no dings) and a thickly padded double coiled saddle add to the convenience and comfort. (Note image still shows Chrome Fenders, chainguard and handlebar, but black is now all standard) So whether you need a reliable ride to commute to work each day, or a bicycle to enjoy for fun and exercise, treat yourself to a classic with the Worksman Urban Commuter, proudly built in our Conway SC USA Factory using domestic and imported parts . For even greater convenience, these bikes will be shipped in a mostly assembled format , so you will easily be able to quickly do the finishing touches and get out on the street. Ladies Frame is an 1" easy Step Through style.
